description: Confirm many uploads after get_upload_urls_batch PUTs. 200 body is { files, errors }. errors is always an array (empty on full success); retry only failed paths. Use confirm_upload for a single file. Does not deploy.

files.description: Same paths that were presigned and PUT.

content_type.description: MIME type for the file. Optional; inferred from the path extension when omitted.

path.description: Site-relative path (e.g. index.html or css/app.css). No leading slash required.

project_id.description: Hosting project UUID from create_project or list_projects.

name: confirm_uploads_batch
title: Confirm uploads (batch)
